sound.music: one continuous gentle music bed under the whole film at 120 bpm (bar starts 1.697 + 2k s): quiet intro (-27.6 LUFS) under the typing, a fuller middle (-11.6 to -15 LUFS) under the conversation 12-45 s, softer under the montage, resolving at the yard (-20 LUFS) and decaying under the end card (-33 LUFS)
sound.speech: all speech is off-screen voice-over between a young child (about 6, speaker A) and their parent (speaker B), conversational, recorded close; nobody on screen speaks; lines sit in the score track (set/lines.json)
sound.effects: UI ticks and the soft whoosh of photos sliding in live inside the score
sound.mix: voice on top, music 8-12 dB under; no sound design beyond the score; the score file already carries the voices (in_score: true)

look.grade: two worlds: the assistant UI is pure black with neutral greys and white type; photos and the final yard are clean, natural, bright daylight; the home videos are warm, soft, slightly grainy phone footage
look.brightness: UI status screens 0-2 (pure black); prompt boxes 13-55; photo cards 80-160 (empty and blue rooms 148-157); home videos 85-142; final yard 78-112; end card 3-4
look.contrast: UI high (white on black); home video medium-soft; final yard natural
look.light: UI self-lit; home video natural window or sun light; final yard clear late-afternoon sun from the left
look.depth_of_field: UI flat; home video phone-deep with some close-ups shallow; final yard deep
look.grain: none on UI; light phone grain on the home videos; none on the final yard

cut30.arc: Hook: the parent types 'pull up photos of our new house in {TOWN}' (0-3.9 s). Middle: searching, the house photos, the empty room ('Uh, that's my room.'), the old room poured into it ('And watch.'), the result and 'Wow, can it be blue?' -> blue walls (3.9-19 s). Payoff: 'So it'll be like our old house?' over the home-video montage, 'It'll be whatever we want it to be.' as the new garden is visualized and becomes real (19-28.5 s). End card 28.5-30.
